What a duplex looks like in Ladner

items.t: The usual duplex form: Individual duplex buildings on single lots across Ladner's residential streets — the detached streets the SSMUH frame now touches, since Delta's SSMUH zoning (Bylaws 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024) allows combinations of single detached dwellings, duplexes, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies, and up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots. A duplex of this class sells whole (building + lot, one title) unless a given parcel was strata-divided into a 2-lot plan or subdivided fee-simple; no individual Ladner parcel in either divided form is verified or named here. Added-unit permission is not permission to subdivide and does not create new lots.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Ladner

items.t: OCP (Delta): Consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), "Housing Our Future," adopted July 8, 2024 — no lettered schedules. The Ladner Area Plan was Schedule B.3 of the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950, 1985; farm land in Bylaw 8400 is designated "Agriculture (A)" (s.1.5.1).

SSMUH position (Delta): Bylaws 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024 — up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots where the zoning applies, in combinations of single detached dwellings, duplexes, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites. Added-unit permission is not permission to subdivide, does not create new lots, and does not waive a hazard or streamside permit area. The duplex is the baseline two-unit form inside this framework; SSMUH does not by itself split a duplex into separately titled halves.

faq.q: Can SSMUH turn my Ladner duplex lot into four lots?
faq.a: No. Bylaws 8394 + 8395 (adopted June 24, 2024) allow up to four units on a single-detached or duplex lot where the zoning applies; added-unit permission is not subdivision permission and creates no new lots.

Delta's Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400, 2024 ("Housing Our Future," adopted July 8, 2024) — a single consolidated plan with no area-plan schedules; the Ladner Area Plan was Schedule B.3 of the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950, 1985.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Ladner?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Ladner?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
